4255 proaireomai {pro-ahee-reh'-om-ahee}

from 4253 and 138;; v

AV - purpose 1; 1

1) to bring forward, bring forth from one's stores
2) to bring forth for one's self, to choose for one's self before
   another, to prefer
3) to purpose
